integrity: Direct exact logarithmic-ratio reformulation yields a coercive strictly convex log-sum-exp Lyapunov function with two conditional log-cosh profiles. Compact strict descent forces projective convergence; an exact scalar affine recursion with coefficient (1-omega)^2 proves unnormalized coupling convergence. Equality and supercritical nonconvergence follow from nondecrease of the same Lyapunov function. A standalone checker independently replays finite examples without treating them as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic theorem for strictly positive 2x2 kernels, both marginals equal to (1/2,1/2), and one constant shared relaxation parameter applied by rows then columns. No claim for unequal marginals, larger dimensions, zero kernel entries, varying parameters, or finite precision. Individual gauge-dependent scaling vectors need not converge.
title: Sharp global relaxation interval for balanced two-by-two Sinkhorn scaling
